warnings: Pile caps on hollow hexagonal piles Dia. 0.15 x 6.00 m: F1 4 piles, F2 6, F3 9, F4 12, all at 0.45 spacing with 0.15 edge distance. No safe load per pile is printed.
main_bar.count is the two-way total (section 6b). F1 and F3 are square, so depth_mm is omitted; F2 and F4 are rectangular (width_mm = the long side, drawn along x on the footing plan).

Depths below ระดับดินเดิม (1.00 to the cap top, cap 0.25 — 0.30 for F4 —, lean concrete 0.05, sand 0.05) are printed against a level that carries no value, so they stay on the elements, not in the grid master z_levels. Every cap is drawn with the stub column C2 at its centre.
